mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days when rates remain below 0.1%.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates falling below 4.0% signal labor market overheating, triggering inflation fears that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts growth (HOUST > 1500) and retail sales decline (RSAFS < 630000) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 AND RSAFS < 630000 but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.5% signals manufacturing weakness, reducing equity returns over 20 days in contraction regimes.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.5% but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 21500) indicates robust economic fundamentals, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 21500 but SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 278.5 triggers central bank rate hike expectations, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 278.5 but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (PAYEMS > 149000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) fuels wage pressures, increasing equity risk and producing negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 149000 AND UNRATE < 4.0% but SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100.5% over 60 days) indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline > 0.5% over 60 days but SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
